items.Title: Web QA
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Role Overview

We are looking for experienced Web Test Analysts to validate enterprise web applications and APIs through functional, integration, regression, and automated testing. The role requires strong API and web automation skills, database validation experience, and the ability to contribute effectively within an Agile quality engineering team.
items.ExternalResponsibilitiesStr:
Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse requirements and prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability coverage for web applications and APIs.

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing across web, API, database, and Linux-based
items.ExternalQualificationsStr:
Mandatory Skills

API testing  |  Web test automation  |  SQL |  Linux

Preferred Skills

Agile/Scrum delivery experience  |  Jira |&
